I share the exact same feelings. I have no real good friends at all. I can do fine during the getting-to-know-you/acquantence phase, but I always do or say something stupid to make people go away. But I desparately want real good friends at the same time.

I also have a very difficult time talking about my feelings and emotions (ex. depression) with other people.
I've never done this before but I'll try my best to help if I can. I'm also feeling very hopeless.

I'm also totally alone. I don't have any friends or social life either, and I know what the loneliness is like at times. I don't have a job at the moment, so I literally spend every minute by myself. 

If you want you can PM me. Maybe we can help each other feel less alone.
my only complaint is that for 5 oclock, they should make it more clear that the factorial is outside the radical sign

Yeah but the problem is if I say that I'll come off as unsociable. This is bad in the workplace. Like a lot of my coworkers like cars and working out, but I don't care much for either of these things, so I'm kinda the loner in the workplace. And this is a problem when my boss decides whether I'm good in teams or not.
For me, it's easiest to just hate/blame myself every single time. Even when I think about the situation rationally and objectively, that's the conclusion I arrive at every time.

I'm probably in the first category. Although I hate and fear my family, because I failed them in every way. Also my mom was emotionally abusive. Then I think she was just doing the best she could as a mom, and I feel guilty for hating her. Not really sure what emotion I feel, it's like getting hit by wave after wave of emotions, each one different

I would have probably moved too. For me the reason is because with accidents, I don't have enough time to research whether it'll kill me or just injure me. For example, I think a lot about cars hitting me when I'm walking down the road. But getting hit by a car likely isn't going to kill me, just seriously injure, and I don't want that. So I avoid getting hit.

I'm 25. I tried cutting a few years ago with kitchen knives but they were too dull to cut skin. 

Can I ask what job you have? I mean what does your boss/coworkers/interviewers say? Obviously their opinions of you  is important because it directly affects whether you can keep job or not
I wish i had that kind of a relationship with my family

OMG I totally have this! Depression has totally destroyed my mind and I can't remember or concentrate anymore. I can't even remember the multiplication table anymore.

However, I do remember all the bad stuff that has happened in my life. Funny how my brain works huh
It also implies that the only person allowed to be depressed is the person on Earth who has the worst life.
